name: web-price-uk-grok-us-only
description: Nathan's question of 2026-10-22 on Qwen3.5-4B, from a UK PC: "Can you lookup the Grok subscription price for me I am thinking of buying it". Yap searched "Grok subscription price 2026" (Exa, userLocation GB) and found x.ai's US tiers; the answer listed them in $ and ended "Note: These are US prices. Let me know if you need help finding the UK pricing…". Stand-in web: every search finds only US prices, whatever it asks. Right: the search names the UK, it looks once more for a UK price, then says in one plain line that it couldn't find UK prices and gives the US ones as they are: no £ price made up, no offer to look further. Run with --locale en-GB.
